sn7.20:1.2: atha kho bhikkhako brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn7.20:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhikkhako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.20:1.4: ahamasmi bho gotama bhikkhako bhavampi bhikkhako idha no kiṃ nānākaraṇanti.
sn7.20:4.1: evaṃ vutte bhikkhako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.20:4.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama. pe.
sn7.20:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
